notes.title: Defend Your Castle 30% off launch discount and XGen Bundle!
notes.content:
We just brought one of our classic games to the Steam platform: Defend Your Castle. You might have gotten in trouble for playing the web version of this game in your computer lab or library at school when you probably were supposed to be studying or researching something important. Sorry teachers! Defend Your Castle is now available alongside Super Motherload (& Motherload Goldium Edition), Stick RPG 2 and The Low Road at a 30% discount if you get them together! Check out the bundle here:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3347/XGen_Studios_Bundle/

Or if you're just looking for a quick dose of nostalgia hop on over to the DYC store page here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/708710/Defend_Your_Castle/

We also just launched both sound tracks for The Low Road on Steam: [i]Songs On The Low Road[/i] by Win Well and [i]The Low Road OST[/i] by Eric Cheng. You can pick them both up in The Low Road Soundtrack Bundle at 30% off regular price (oh and there's a 30% launch discount too... so let's just say CHEAP!).

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4978/The_Low_Road_Soundtrack_Bundle/

Most of all, thank you for playing our games!

- The XGen Studios Team
